# web

> Serves the browser-facing routes and UI.

<!-- Generated by scripts/modules/generate-agents.mjs from module.manifest.json
     and module.narrative.md. Edit those, not this file. -->

Owns the App Router shell — `layout.tsx`, `page.tsx`, `globals.css`,
`providers/`, and the `papers/[paperId]` route — plus the signed-out ingest landing.

## Interface

Entrypoint: `page.tsx`

## Children

Route by goal — you should not need to open more than one.

- **web.api** (`src/app/api`) — Adapts HTTP requests to the server modules that do the work.
- **web.block-editor** (`src/app/components/block-editor`) — Edits a paper as a flat array of typed blocks.
- **web.chat** (`src/app/components/chat`) — Answers questions about the open paper beside it.
- **web.workspace** (`src/app/components/workspace`) — Composes the paper reading surface.

## Constraints

Work outside these has left this module. Stop and ask rather than widening the boundary.

- routing
- layout
- theming

## Checks

Green here means the bounded work is done — no need to run the whole repo.

```bash
pnpm vitest run src/app
```
